lock.command: node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs lock; node scripts/edition-authoring/cli.mjs check

views.command: node src/base/contract-docs.mjs write; node src/base/contract-docs.mjs check; git checkout origin/main -- ACCEPTANCE.md docs/CLAIMS.md

restored_views_check.command: node src/base/contract-docs.mjs check after restoring origin/main views
restored_views_check.expected_failure: ACCEPTANCE.md: generated content differs; run contract-docs write.
